name: Elf of Era! Idols Project
source:
When people think of the word dream in their minds, they always have a helpless smile and regret. Dreams are always accompanied by the heavy pressure of life, slowly deflated in the pocket, and we who used to have dreams often bow to reality.

But if you had a chance to fight against reality and realize your dreams, what would you choose?

In this work, the five girls will also face various realities and choices. Can they guard their dreams that seem so far away?

Please go and witness, witness the story that belongs only to brave dreamers.

[Translated from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2414730/]Steam[/url]]
